verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' agent-analysis docs describe success evaluation with custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement (resolution) and customer satisfaction, plus sentiment analysis and structured data extraction across completed conversations. Underperforming real conversations can also be turned into test cases. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the evaluation is LLM-driven and runs automatically on every call, explicit failure flagging or alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
